notes: Reached by plain direct fetch, no proxy (as in the prior Home-Decor pass). robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic-ai agent; only cart/account/search paths are disallowed. /en-ae/ 301s to the bare host and canonical category URLs are https://www.theone.com/category/<slug>, already serving the en-ae UAE catalogue. TREE: the full mega-menu (every department and every child) is present in the homepage HTML; departments are Living, Dining, Bed & Bath, Home Decor, Lighting, plus New and Sale. New/* and Sale/* mirror the whole tree and were dropped as section 3 navigation junk, as were All <Department> nodes and the five modular-sofa landing pages (all-modular-sofas, leopold-/light-/sunlight-sp-/sydney-modular-sofa) and /category/pinball-machines. There is no outdoor/garden or bathroom-furniture department on this site. QTY: the listing header (#km-plp-count, label ' Items') is filled client-side from result.count of the page's own GET to engine.kartmax.in/api/fast/search/v1/9dd12b5a96ce9a456540475ea0b340e1/plp-special. The query string was copied verbatim from each category page's inline script - the category identity is the fieldspecials _uuid, and the page's own request also pins overall_stock_status~in-stock and country=en-ae, so the number is the shopper-visible population. Per Rule 1 the API number was not trusted on its own: every non-zero leaf was paged to exhaustion at count=100/page and the unique product_id total matched result.count exactly (25/25 non-zero leaves), with the following page returning zero tiles. Each page's h1 was checked against the intended category (all matched; the Coffee Tables page renders an empty h1 but its 18 products are all coffee tables). SANITY: counts vary per category and children sum to their parents - Armchairs & Stools 19+7=26, Coffee Tables & Accent Tables 18+3+20=41, Living Room Storage 0+2+3=5, Home Office 0+1+13=14, Living 60+26+41+5+14=146, Dining Tables 0+2+11+3=16, Dining Chairs 2+11=13, Dining Room Storage 0+1=1, Bar Furniture & Barware 0+0+5=5, Bedroom Furniture 1+3+8=12, Dressers & Mirrors 9+3+0=12, Bedroom Accessories 17+10=27. Sofas is the one exception (children 61 vs parent 60), consistent with one product being filed in two sofa children; leaf numbers are used regardless. EXCLUDED as not furniture: Sofa Accessories (1 - a sofa headrest, a furniture part), Home Office Accessories (13 - bookends, waste cans, an office board), Bar Accessories (5 - bottle openers, champagne coolers), Bedroom Accessories > Bedroom Accessories (17 - jewellery organisers, ring holders, decorative boxes), and the whole Home Decor, Lighting, Bedlinen, Duvets & Pillows, Mattresses (incl. Mattress Toppers & Pads and the standalone /category/mattresses-covers), Towels & Bath Accessories, Table Linen, Kitchenware and Tableware branches. Product titles were read for every ambiguous node before deciding. ZERO ROWS: 11 leaves are live nav categories with working listing URLs that currently list 0 products (verified 0 with the in-stock filter removed too, and the HTML shows the site's own empty-state block). They are emitted with qty 0 and flagged rather than dropped or guessed.
